definition: going by and beyond a certain point
description: A narrow road through an alpine village on a sunny summer day, with wooden chalets, green meadows and snow-capped mountains under a blue sky. A young woman in a blue cycling jersey and helmet rides a road bike along the road towards the viewer, going by an old red tractor pulling a trailer piled high with hay, and moves ahead of it with a smile. A young man drives the tractor. A brown cow grazes in a field beside a stone wall on the left.

de.answer: Sie fährt an einem Traktor vorbei.
